profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
Qualcomm peripheral team technical lead(USB/Storage/Sensor/PCIe/I2C/SPI...) in QC chipset and Manager role for developing team member career. Good relationship with team members for solving hard issues. Big customers (SS,Apple,LGE,SoMC,Xiaomi,..) project launch support experiences.

USB tech lead from 2008
Apple Iphone/IpadHSIC I/F commercialization contribution.
Comprehensive knowledge from USB h/w layer to USB s/w architecture. Power management & customization knowledge. USB 1.1/2.0/3.0/3.1/3.2 USB PD
Following up future converged IO standard

Storage(especially UFS/SDCard) Tech lead from 2016
Experience for UFS 2.0/2.1/3.0 platform and Resolving hard UFS issues from major customer mobile phone working with H/W design team through scope and analyzer for identifying s/w racing conditions
Intensive relationship with UFS vendors(Samsung, Toshiba, SKHynix, San Disk, Micron)

PCIe tech lead from 2017
PCIe issue debugging from h/w level and driver level for customer PCIe H/W component
Understanding PCIe 2.0/3.0 spec and working in PCIe Gen3 2 lane configuration for 5G communication
Working in Qualcomm 5G system IPC connection for tethering support and Preparing customer doc for peripherals

Specialties: 
Comprehensive understanding of USB(HSUSB/HSIC/SSUSB/Type-C), Storage(UFS/eMMC/SDCard), PCIe HW/SW
Experience with last 10 years QC mobile chipsets by peripheral support.
Device driver development and Debugging skill (Qualcomm OS, Linux)
Familiar with Windows Host PC USB/PCIe driver
Good at customer facing doc publish to meet customer's expectation.

positions.title: Principal Engineer/Manager
positions.description:
As Qualcomm chip peripheral customer engineering lead in (USB/Stoage(UFS/eMMC/SDCard)/PCIe/IOBus(UART/SPI/I2C)/Sensor), Build up different tech area as one team for consistent looking from customer perspective.

Running IOT lab for UFS storage for checking compatibility issues before customer mass production. Interacting with Samsung/Toshiba/SKHynix/San Disk/Micron vendors

Covering from s/w driver to h/w signal protocol & signal integrity check and found chip issue or s/w driver hole for racing conditions

Supporting from major mobile customers(Samsung, LGE,  SoMC, Xiaomi, OnePlus..)  design review to get TA for final commercial product 

Automotive industry experience with telematic module/MirrorLink/CarPlay debugging related with USB/PCIe for LGE/Panasonic/GM/Harman Kardon/Ford projects
Consulting IoT customers design from design stage
Working on new 5G system customer docs from design understanding
Comprehensive Qualcomm platform I/F understanding

positions.title: SW ENG
positions.description:
BSP layer development. Especially focused on Power management.
Optimize power consumption considering 2G GSM /3G WCDMA operation

positions.title: Senior Staff SW Engineer

positions.description:

CDMA PCMCIA module integration with iPAQ series, PC(Win98, WinME,
Win2K,winXP)

positions.title: Senior Staff SW engineer
positions.description:
Startup company. Joined as one of founders
Developing device driver for window, Linux for video capturing/playing using DV format, 
Developing PVR device(PCI card, USB standalone type) for PC user

positions.title: Senior sw engineer
positions.description:

Lexmark engine)
